item.tib: gsung gi lha mchog rnam grags ngar chen dkyil 'khor gyi mchod khrigs 'phrin ring chu gter dga' ba'i rol dbyangs
item.coloph: de ltar srid gsum rin chen mdzes pa'i pho brang gi lha dang zhing khams kyi bkod pa gsal bar ston pa yid 'dzin me tog ge sar rgyan gyi 'phreng ba zhes bya ba/ dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i ming can gyis rnam par rgyal ba'i lha'i khang bzang gi nang du bkod pa dge legs 'phel//
